3	/// spec-7-1/spec-7-2 — the export job's own progress, modeled as its own
4	/// sealed domain entity (AD-12: never force `status`+`narrativeStatus`
5	/// into `Resource<T>`), mirroring `BookmarkState`'s own shape: sealed,
6	/// with `const factory` constructors declared on the base class so call
7	/// sites read as `ExportJobState.preparing()` rather than naming each
8	/// subclass directly. Exactly the 6 states `docs/input/backend/export-
9	/// screen-states.md`'s own status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
10	/// collapses into — `data_ready` got its own [ExportJobState.dataReady]
11	/// case in spec-7-2, once its own download button had something real to
12	/// wire.
13	///
14	/// Never persisted (AD-15: ephemeral, polled live) — lives only on
15	/// `ExportJobCubit.state`.
16	sealed class ExportJobState {
17	  const ExportJobState();
18	
19	  /// `status: 'pending'` — spinner, "Preparando exportação...". Also this
20	  /// cubit's own initial state, since `export-summary-create`'s 202
21	  /// response always answers `status: 'pending'` (`openapi.yaml`), so no
22	  /// separate "creating..." state is needed before that call resolves.
23	  const factory ExportJobState.preparing() = ExportJobPreparing;
24	
25	  /// `status: 'processing'` — progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA...",
26	  /// no download of any kind yet.
27	  const factory ExportJobState.generating() = ExportJobGenerating;
28	
29	  /// `status: 'data_ready'` — spec-7-2's own state: the raw export file
30	  /// is ready to download while `narrativeStatus` is still `processing`
31	  /// underneath it. Renders the same progress-bar/text treatment as
32	  /// [ExportJobState.generating], plus the "Baixar dados brutos" button
33	  /// rendered already enabled beneath (no PDF button here — a PDF folds
34	  /// the narrative in, which isn't done yet).
35	  const factory ExportJobState.dataReady() = ExportJobDataReady;
36	
37	  /// `status: 'done'` — [outcome] distinguishes "Concluído" (narrative
38	  /// succeeded, both download buttons shown) from "Narrativa falhou/
39	  /// pulada" (only the raw-data button, copy scoped to the narrative
40	  /// failure) without needing two separate sealed variants for what is,
41	  /// to the job itself, one and the same terminal success.
42	  const factory ExportJobState.done(ExportOutcome outcome) = ExportJobDone;
43	
44	  /// `status: 'error'`, any `errorCode` other than `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` —
45	  /// generic error copy, no download, non-retryable/terminal. [failure]
46	  /// is always built via the one shared `Failure.fromCode` (AD-3) — never
47	  /// a second, ad hoc mapping of the raw `errorCode` string.
48	  const factory ExportJobState.error(Failure failure) = ExportJobError;
49	
50	  /// `status: 'error'`, `errorCode: 'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD'` — "Nenhum
51	  /// registro nesse período." + an adjust-period suggestion, no download.
52	  /// AD-3 ("reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod`... never add a
53	  /// new `Failure` subtype") is honored one layer down, in
54	  /// `ExportJobStatusDto.toState()`: that mapping step always goes
55	  /// through `Failure.fromCode` first and only reaches this case by
56	  /// checking the *subtype* it returns — this variant itself carries no
57	  /// `Failure` of its own, since by the time the job-level state is
58	  /// "empty period" there is nothing further for the UI to do with one
59	  /// (no retry, no message beyond the copy above).
60	  const factory ExportJobState.emptyPeriod() = ExportJobEmptyPeriod;
61	}
62	
63	/// The default state — outline spinner, tappable only via "Fechar".
64	class ExportJobPreparing extends ExportJobState {
65	  const ExportJobPreparing();
66	
67	  @override
68	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobPreparing;
69	
70	  @override
71	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobPreparing).hashCode;
72	
73	  @override
74	  String toString() => 'ExportJobPreparing()';
75	}
76	
77	class ExportJobGenerating extends ExportJobState {
78	  const ExportJobGenerating();
79	
80	  @override
81	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobGenerating;
82	
83	  @override
84	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobGenerating).hashCode;
85	
86	  @override
87	  String toString() => 'ExportJobGenerating()';
88	}
89	
90	/// See [ExportJobState.dataReady]'s own doc — mirrors [ExportJobPreparing]'s
91	/// no-field shape.
92	class ExportJobDataReady extends ExportJobState {
93	  const ExportJobDataReady();
94	
95	  @override
96	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobDataReady;
97	
98	  @override
99	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobDataReady).hashCode;
100	
101	  @override
102	  String toString() => 'ExportJobDataReady()';
103	}
104	
105	/// [ExportJobDone]'s own two flavors — never a boolean, so a third future
106	/// outcome (unlikely, but the taxonomy's own `narrativeStatus` enum has
107	/// exactly `done`/`failed`/`skipped`, the latter two collapsing here into
108	/// one) never silently reads as the wrong one of only two choices.
109	enum ExportOutcome {
110	  /// `narrativeStatus: 'done'` — "Resumo pronto", both the PDF and the
111	  /// raw-data buttons enabled (spec-7-2).
112	  narrativeReady,
113	
114	  /// `narrativeStatus in {failed, skipped}` — only the raw-data button,
115	  /// enabled (spec-7-2), copy scoped to the narrative failure, not a
116	  /// job-wide error.
117	  narrativeUnavailable,
118	}
119	
120	class ExportJobDone extends ExportJobState {
121	  const ExportJobDone(this.outcome);
122	
123	  final ExportOutcome outcome;
124	
125	  @override
126	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
127	      identical(this, other) ||
128	      (other is ExportJobDone && other.outcome == outcome);
129	
130	  @override
131	  int get hashCode => outcome.hashCode;
132	
133	  @override
134	  String toString() => 'ExportJobDone(outcome: $outcome)';
135	}
136	
137	/// The job itself failed — red warning, terminal (I/O matrix: "Non-
138	/// retryable, terminal"). [failure] is kept for parity with
139	/// `BookmarkError`'s own shape, even though the sheet only ever needs
140	/// generic error copy, never [failure].message, for this variant (the
141	/// taxonomy's own 13 codes carry no export-specific text).
142	class ExportJobError extends ExportJobState {
143	  const ExportJobError(this.failure);
144	
145	  final Failure failure;
146	
147	  @override
148	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
149	      identical(this, other) ||
150	      (other is ExportJobError && other.failure == failure);
151	
152	  @override
153	  int get hashCode => failure.hashCode;
154	
155	  @override
156	  String toString() => 'ExportJobError(failure: $failure)';
157	}
158	
159	/// "Período vazio" — see [ExportJobState.emptyPeriod]'s own doc for why
160	/// this variant carries no [Failure] of its own.
161	class ExportJobEmptyPeriod extends ExportJobState {
162	  const ExportJobEmptyPeriod();
163	
164	  @override
165	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobEmptyPeriod;
166	
167	  @override
168	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobEmptyPeriod).hashCode;
169	
170	  @override
171	  String toString() => 'ExportJobEmptyPeriod()';
172	}
173

3	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
4	import '../entities/export_download_format.dart';
5	import '../entities/export_job_state.dart';
6	
7	/// The export feature's one port (RNF06) — `features/export/presentation`
8	/// depends on this abstract class only, never `export/data` directly.
9	/// Every method returns `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).
10	abstract class ExportRepository {
11	  /// Calls `export-summary-create` (`ApiClient.post`) — RF05's own job
12	  /// kickoff for the period [periodStart]..[periodEnd]. Returns the
13	  /// created job's `jobId` on success. `RetryInterceptor.
14	  /// neverRetriedFunctions` already excludes this call from any
15	  /// transparent retry (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key) — every
16	  /// [Failure] here, including a theoretical synchronous rejection,
17	  /// propagates as `Left`, unmapped.
18	  Future<Either<Failure, String>> createJob({
19	    required DateTime periodStart,
20	    required DateTime periodEnd,
21	  });
22	
23	  /// Calls `export-status-get` (`ApiClient.get`, [jobId] appended as the
24	  /// one trailing path segment) and maps the response straight into
25	  /// [ExportJobState] — a thin pass-through, no cache (AD-15: ephemeral,
26	  /// polled live). `Left` here is a transport-level failure only
27	  /// (offline/timeout/malformed) — a backend-reported job failure
28	  /// (including the empty-period case) already arrives as a
29	  /// `Right(ExportJobState.error(...))`/`Right(ExportJobState.
30	  /// emptyPeriod())`, never as a `Left`.
31	  Future<Either<Failure, ExportJobState>> getStatus(String jobId);
32	
33	  /// Calls `export-download-get` (`ApiClient.getRedirectLocation`, [jobId]
34	  /// trailing, [format] as the `format` query parameter) — returns the
35	  /// signed Storage URL carried in the `302`'s `Location` header, never
36	  /// the body of a followed redirect (Boundaries: "never auto-follow into
37	  /// the signed-storage host"). `Left` here covers a transport failure, a
38	  /// backend error response, and a missing `Location` header alike — all
39	  /// three are surfaced by `ExportJobCubit` the same way (Design Notes: an
40	  /// inline `SnackBar`, never a job-status state mutation).
41	  Future<Either<Failure, String>> getDownloadUrl(
42	    String jobId, {
43	    required ExportDownloadFormat format,
44	  });
45	}

type: 'feature'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `export-summary-create`'s summary — "synchronous count, enqueues the job" — plus `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`'s `400`/non-retryable entry in `error-taxonomy.md` mean the backend rejects the *create* call itself for a zero-Entry period, never issuing a `jobId`. `ExportJobCubit.start()` doesn't special-case this: every create failure emits the generic `ExportJobState.error(failure)` and returns `false`, which `MeusRegistrosScreen._onExportTap()` reads as "never open the sheet, show an inline `SnackBar` instead." The user sees "Não foi possível gerar a exportação.", not the prototype's "Período vazio" sheet state.

**Approach:** In `start()`'s create-failure branch, special-case `failure is ExportEmptyPeriod`: emit `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()` (already exists, built for the poll path in Story 7.1) and return `true` instead of `false` — the screen's existing `if (started) { ExportStatusSheet.show(...) }` then opens the sheet unchanged, landing directly on the already-correct "Período vazio" content. No `jobId` is stored and polling never starts.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Only functional change: `ExportJobCubit.start()`'s create-failure handler. No change to `ExportJobState`, `ExportJobStatusDto`, `ExportStatusSheet`, or `MeusRegistrosScreen`.
- On this branch, `_jobId` stays `null`, `_startPolling()` is never called.
- Reuse `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod`/`ExportEmptyPeriod` (AD-3) via an `is` check — never a new `Failure` subtype or a string check on `failure.message`.
- Every other create-failure subtype keeps today's behavior: `ExportJobState.error(failure)`, returns `false`, sheet never opens.

**Ask First:** None — the contract (create endpoint's "synchronous count" summary + `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`'s `400` entry) is specific enough to settle the delivery path without a human call.

**Never:** touch the DTO's existing poll-path `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` → `emptyPeriod()` mapping (`export_job_status_dto.dart`) — leave it as defensive coverage in case the backend ever also reports it there; touch `ExportStatusSheet._contentFor`'s empty-period copy/layout (already matches the prototype exactly); add a new `Failure` subtype or new `ExportJobState` variant.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
| Create rejected, empty period | `createJob` → `Left(Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(...))` | `start()` emits `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`, returns `true`; sheet opens on "Período vazio" | N/A |
| Create rejected, other failure | `createJob` → `Left(Failure.networkOffline(...))` (unchanged) | emits `ExportJobState.error(failure)`, returns `false` | inline `SnackBar`, sheet never opens (existing, untouched) |
| Empty-period terminal, no poll | After the above | `_jobId` stays `null`; elapsing time never triggers `getStatus` | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart:76-80` -- `start()`'s `result.match` failure branch -- add the `is ExportEmptyPeriod` check (Approach). Only line-level change in this spec.
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31` -- `ExportEmptyPeriod` (exists, Story 7.1) -- read-only, used for the `is` check.
- `lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart:60,161-172` -- `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()` (exists) -- read-only, emitted as-is.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:196-241` -- `_onExportTap` -- read-only; its `if (started) { ExportStatusSheet.show(...) }` already opens the sheet once `start()` returns `true`.
- `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart:195-202` -- `ExportJobEmptyPeriod()` render case (exists) -- read-only.
- `test/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit_test.dart:171-194` -- sibling to the existing "Create fails" test, for the new branch.
- `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart:326-350` -- sibling to the existing poll-path "Período vazio" e2e test, for the create-path.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- branch `start()`'s create-failure handler on `failure is ExportEmptyPeriod` -- closes the one path (contract: `export-summary-create`'s synchronous rejection) not already covered by Story 7.1's poll-path handling in the DTO.
- [x] `test/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit_test.dart` -- unit test: `createJobResult = left(const Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: ...))` → `started` is `true`, `cubit.state` is `ExportJobEmptyPeriod`, elapsing a poll interval never calls `getStatus`.
- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` -- e2e test: queue a single `400` response `{'code': 'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD', 'message': ..., 'retryable': false}` to `export-summary-create`, drive the real `ExportJobCubit` through DI, assert `cubit.state is ExportJobEmptyPeriod` and that `export-status-get` is never requested.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a period with zero Entries, when the user requests an export and `export-summary-create` rejects synchronously with `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`, then the sheet opens directly into "Período vazio" (no download button, "Fechar" only) — never a generic error `SnackBar`, never a crash.
- Given that empty-period state, then no poll ever fires — there was never a `jobId` to poll.
- Given a different create failure (any other `Failure` subtype), then today's existing behavior is unchanged: inline `SnackBar`, sheet never opens.

## Design Notes

`start()` returning `true` here is deliberate: for this one case its boolean stops meaning "job created" and starts meaning "safe to open the sheet" — the sheet shows "Período vazio" with no underlying job, mirroring what the empty-period AC already forces on the sheet itself.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test test/features/export/` -- all pass, including the two new tests

## Suggested Review Order

**The create-failure branch (entry point)**

- The only functional change: special-cases `ExportEmptyPeriod` so `start()` returns `true`/emits `emptyPeriod()` instead of the generic error path.
  [`export_job_cubit.dart:88`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L88)

- `start()`'s own doc comment, updated to state the carve-out this branch introduces.
  [`export_job_cubit.dart:64-66`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart#L64-L66)

**Where the exception now has to be honored downstream**

- `_onExportTap`'s doc comment — the hand-off this change relies on: `start() == true` already falls through to `ExportStatusSheet.show(...)` unchanged.
  [`meus_registros_screen.dart:195-197`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L195-L197)

- `ExportStatusSheet`'s own class doc, same carve-out noted at the sheet's own Boundaries quote.
  [`export_status_sheet.dart:23-26`](../../lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart#L23-L26)

**Tests — the one new behavior, verified at three depths**

- Unit: the cubit emits `emptyPeriod()`/returns `true`/never polls, against a fake repository.
  [`export_job_cubit_test.dart:196`](../../test/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit_test.dart#L196)

- E2e: the same outcome through the real DI graph and a mocked HTTP 400, proving the wiring from `Failure.fromCode` through.
  [`export_flow_e2e_test.dart:355`](../../test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart#L355)

- Widget: the actual user-visible gap this review round caught — the real sheet opens on "Período vazio" through `MeusRegistrosScreen`, not a `SnackBar`.
  [`meus_registros_screen_test.dart:1772`](../../test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart#L1772)
